title: symphyotrichum parviflorum
intro: Symphyotrichum parviflorum, commonly known as small white aster, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, sore throats, and coughs due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Symphyotrichum parviflorum include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
